operating_notes.text: Cyber-security incident reported on May 16, 2026, involving an anonymous claim of access to portions of IT infrastructure.
Equity yields were 58 bps blended (61 bps active equity), debt 28 bps and liquid 13 bps monthly for Q1FY27.
Industry SIP contributions were ₹31,800 Cr in June 2026, up 17% YoY from ₹27,300 Cr; HDFC AMC's systematic transactions (SIP+STP) were ₹4,810 Cr.
Alternatives management fee is 80-90 bps depending on product, above the mutual fund equity business.
Q2FY27 operating margin was 36 bps of AAUM.
Active equity yield was 61 bps in Q2FY27; debt yield 28-29 bps; liquid 13 bps.
EPFO fixed income mandate management commenced in Q2FY27.
AIF Category II Select Opportunities Fund and Category III Emerging Opportunities Fund launched.

timeline.summary: HDFC AMC reported FY26 total revenue of ₹4,620 Cr, up 18% YoY, and recommended a dividend of ₹54 per share.
HDFC AMC disclosed a cyber-security incident involving a communication from an anonymous source claiming access to portions of its IT infrastructure.
HDFC AMC disclosed that promoter HDFC Bank held 22.44 crore shares with zero encumbrance for FY26.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,170.22 Cr (+13.9% YoY), net profit ₹748.73 Cr (+4.2% YoY).
HDFC AMC reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹1,169 Cr (+14% YoY) and net profit of ₹750 Cr (+4% YoY).

HDFC Asset Management Company Limited hosted Q2 FY27 earnings call on October 15, 2026, with audio recording uploaded by **Sonali Nitin Chandak**, **Chandak**, and **Sonali Chandak** digitally signed.

watchlist.response: Navneet Munot declined to read into one quarter's movement, citing the accounting change; Naozad Sirwalla gave yields (equity 58 bps, debt 28 bps, liquid 13 bps, active equity 61 bps) but no forward trajectory
watchlist.text: Repeated questions on the QoQ yield uptick and whether it is a new baseline after the TER-to-BER change

watchlist.response: CFO said it is 'not a big number either way' and pointed to annual disclosures, without giving the quarterly amount

status_history.evidence: Management clarified that CSR expenses in Q1 skewed H1 cost numbers.

watchlist.text: Analyst asked for the CSR expense figure behind the opex rise

watchlist.response: Munot clarified it is a gross number including switches between funds, and declined to give fintech's share of the channel
watchlist.text: Analyst questioned the 8.6 million fintech SIP registrations in one quarter as implausibly high

watchlist.response: CFO said it is the Board's prerogative and referred to the Chairman's AGM remarks; no plan given
Management views competition as validation of industry potential and remains confident in its 30-year track record and distribution network.
watchlist.text: Market share stagnation and competition from newer AMCs.

watchlist.response: Largely attributed to asset mix changes rather than a material structural shift.
